content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: On sales invoice:new, the user opens Customer (list) from a tab click (events 271, 274, 280) and returns to sales invoice:new (322, 328) about 1.8-2.0 s later, which suggests the Customer field sends users to the customer list to find a customer; the events do not show why they returned.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new screen, change the Customer combobox so that its find or create action opens customer:list in a new tab or side panel instead of navigating away, so the unsaved invoice form is kept.", "cited_event_ids": ["271", "274", "280", "322", "328"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["Why the user returned to sales invoice:new is not in the events.", "The reason for the tab click (271) is not visible in the events.", "Whether the form draft is lost on navigation is not shown in the events.", "The 'Customer (list)' screen and the Customer combobox are not confirmed as the same flow in the events."]}
